pattern: Field description referenced by aria-describedby, with aria-invalid on the target for errors (HTML/ARIA).

aria.value: Host id added while a message is shown; other ids are kept

"true" while an error-tone message is shown; removed when the tone changes, the message clears, or the target changes, but only if this message set it. An aria-invalid="true" the consumer set beforehand is never removed

keyboard.action: Not focusable; the message is read with the target when the target is focused.

focus: Not focusable and never moves focus.
notes: Tones pair color with a distinct icon; the message text must still state the problem.
Only the error tone marks the target invalid; warning, success, and info are descriptive only.
The message is not a live region; announce important changes separately if the user is not on the target.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader reading of the description has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
